name: jb-rm-workbench
description: Agentic Relationship Manager workbench for the Julius Baer SingHacks 2026 challenge

scripts.db:reset: npm run migrate -w @jb/db && npm run seed -w @jb/db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @jb/api" "npm run dev -w @jb/web"
scripts.py:check: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w" -w /w/services/analytics python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install -q -e '.[dev]' >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format --check . && ruff check . && mypy app && pytest -q"
scripts.py:format: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w" -w /w/services/analytics python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install -q ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format . && ruff check --fix ."
